finding.title: Stop testing the stale copy of AddTrackFlowScreen._getSmartDefault in add_track_result_test.dart — it asserts pre-fix buggy behavior

evidence.quote:
final c = _state.curriculumId;
      if (c != null) return curriculumLabelText(ref, curriculum: c);

finding.why: Commit 1fead3de ("fix: resolve 14 defects from run-7 on-device E2E audit", the wave immediately preceding this one) fixed a real user-visible bug: the track-setup wizard's smart default name showed the last-selected scope value (e.g. 'Seder Zeraim') instead of the curriculum label, so the post-creation snackbar didn't match the Track Management hub card title. The fix rewrote the real `_getSmartDefault()` to always call `curriculumLabelText(ref, curriculum: c)`. add_track_result_test.dart never imports that method — a private test-local copy (comment: 'Extracted logic from AddTrackFlow for unit testing') still implements the PRE-fix logic (`return state.scopeSelections!.last.value;`), and the test 'uses scope value when scope narrowed' asserts exactly the behavior the fix removed, still expecting 'סדר זרעים'. If this bug is ever reintroduced by a refactor, this suite stays green — the only 'smart default' test in the repo exercises dead code, not the shipped method. A second copy, `_hasProgramsForCurriculum`, duplicates the currently-correct `AddTrackFlowStateX.hasProgramsForCurriculum` and will silently drift the next time a curriculum gains/loses a seeded program.
finding.recommendation: Delete the private `_getSmartDefault`/`_hasProgramsForCurriculum` reimplementations and the 'Smart track name defaults' group. Either extract the real logic into a small ref-free pure function shared by add_track_flow_screen.dart and the test, or move this coverage into a widget/controller test that exercises the real method. Have `_hasProgramsForCurriculum` call `AddTrackFlowStateX.hasProgramsForCurriculum` directly instead of re-typing the curriculum list.
acceptance_criteria: add_track_result_test.dart contains no private reimplementation of AddTrackFlowScreen logic; it calls the real production symbol.

A test asserts that with scopeSelections set and no program, the smart default equals the curriculum label (current fixed behavior), not the last scope value — a red-first regression test for the F-05/F-21/run7 fix.
git grep for a private '_getSmartDefault' outside add_track_flow_screen.dart (or its extracted helper) and this test returns nothing.
